c0422.texto: The gross pay, employer payroll taxes, monthly cost and annual cost columns are TOTALS for the row: for a position with two people they include both. FTE is the share of a full-time week for each person, and it is used to compare pay with the legal minimum in proportion; the TOTAL row multiplies it by the people in each position, so it gives the full-time equivalents of the whole team. The payroll tax rate and the number of pay periods are in the "0. Assumptions" tab.
c0422.motivo: E4: el total de FTE es Σ personas × FTE
